profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Bloomberg | Backend & Data Infrastructure | Distributed Systems | Python, Java, C++
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience building and owning backend and distributed systems. I design and operate reliable services that support business-critical applications.

Currently at Bloomberg, I work on financial-data publishing and calculation pipelines, with a focus on data correctness, performance, and production reliability. My experience includes improving existing systems, resolving complex data-processing issues, and supporting major product launches and migrations. 

Core interests: backend infrastructure, distributed systems, cloud platforms, data pipelines, and performance optimization.

Technologies: Python, Java, C++, SQL, AWS, Kafka.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design, develop, and maintain backend systems supporting large-scale financial data processing, calculation, and publishing.

• Improve the performance, correctness, and reliability of distributed data pipelines through system optimization, testing, and production troubleshooting.

• Lead engineering initiatives involving data platform modernization, historical data processing, and cross-functional delivery.

Technologies: Python, Java, Kafka, SQL, Oracle Database.
positions.insights: Systems Design, Apache Kafka and +9 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained user-facing features for Vanguard’s Personal Advisor Services website.
 
• Enhanced the existing Angular codebase to improve functionality and user experience.

• Led the migration of Angular components into Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) for better content management.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Developed cloud-native solutions for the Performance Attribution team, enhancing data workflows in AWS.
  
• Utilized AWS services including Lambda, Glue, Athena, S3, CloudFormation, EC2, and IAM for scalability.
  
• Designed and deployed Blue Prism bots to automate vendor operations, integrating with Bamboo CI for monitoring.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented backend APIs in Java and C++ for the Low Power Radar program, enhancing data exchange efficiency.
 
• Developed a Java Recorder API to capture protocol buffer messages, improving system diagnostics and validation. 

• Led integration events to validate C++-based UDP interfaces, ensuring compatibility with partner hardware through thorough testing.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a continuous integration environment using Apache ANT and Jenkins, enhancing workflow efficiency for the Small Package Sort System team.

• Created a dynamic web dashboard for real-time visualization of package sort metrics, improving operational transparency.

• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of new tools and processes.
